title: Our American Symbols — One Nation Under God
memory_verse: "Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord." — Psalm 33:12 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about important American symbols and what it means to be 'one nation under God.'
content: America has many special symbols that remind us of our country. The American flag, the bald eagle, and the Statue of Liberty are some of them.
When we say the Pledge of Allegiance, we say 'one nation under God.' This means our country was built to honor God.
The Liberty Bell has a Bible verse on it! It says 'Proclaim liberty throughout all the land' from Leviticus 25:10. Our founders knew that freedom comes from God.
These symbols remind us that America is a special nation. We should thank God for our freedom and pray for our country every day.
activity: Draw your favorite American symbol and write why it is important. Practice saying the Pledge of Allegiance together.
discussion: What does 'one nation under God' mean?
What is your favorite American symbol and why?
How can we show love for our country?
